display_name: Megabuilding H1 — basement lift-repair workshop (Gig: Going Up or Down?)
why: This is the basement of Megabuilding H1 in the Glen: sublevels holding the building's lift-repair workshop, reached by the building lift from the ground-floor concourse above, which is already a live courtyard with vendors, a musician, kids and homeless regulars. Only the workshop itself is quest-authored, and in a world without gigs it is missing along with El Gallo (Juan Troy), the building's brilliant but drug-addicted technician. The proposal loads that one quest section and puts El Gallo back at his routine work, so H1 reads as a working megablock rather than a locked basement.

open_questions: Check the H1 basement lift: vanilla's gig phase disables floors 1 and 2 and the clean slate runs no such action, so confirm all three stops land on real geometry (the workshop is floor 0 at z about 5.3).
Walk into the basement workshop with no gig running: its door controller is unpowered and force-closed in vanilla, so confirm the runtime door policy opens it or record what blocks it.

Confirm the workshop renders cleanly: the streetstory prefab brings El Gallo's den (bed, tools, conversation scene prefab) and may z-fight with the base H1 basement or leave quest-only triggers (shotgun, prevention areas) visible.
Check El Gallo is calm and on post: he should be kneeling over tools or on his tablet in the workshop, not in the Talk stance, and the drug-inhale spot is his vanilla routine.
Check the ground-floor courtyard crowd the kept hey_gle_phase already activates (vendors, musician, kids, homeless) is present without this entry and not double-spawned by it.

communities.why: El Gallo is H1's lift technician, so he belongs in the basement workshop in normal play. rout is his work routine: four relaxed spots (kneeling over a tool, using a tablet, standing at the dirt routine, and his syn-coke inhale). Vanilla's street-story phases activate exactly this entry and phase; Talk is the pre-gig conversation stance and Combat3 is the gig fight, so neither is used.

variant_toggles.why: Keeps the post-gig variant off, so the venue stays in its pre-story, intact state. It is off by default and vanilla only turns it on from the (gated) community phase, but asserting 0 documents the intended look and survives a stale save.

The normal lit look: lamps on, quest electrical/damage fixtures off. Both values are already the pre-gig defaults (lights_on enabled by default, devices off); vanilla sets them ungated before the fight and flips to lights off plus devices on only for the combat state, which is not used.

proximity_wait.why: The building lift that brings the player down into the workshop basement, at (-1602.6, -555.9, 5.4) beside El Gallo's spots; it is a device entity vanilla drives here (LiftControllerPS), and every player entering the workshop passes it, so the anchored re-issue fires exactly when the basement streams.
